label: d/s/x input early in original phase, boosted by first token z/b/k/l
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase at steps 2-7 (peak t=3-4; ~97% of mass); never at t=0-1, never in the copy phase, weakly on some <DEL> steps. Two graded factors combine: the current input (d strongest, 11x lift and 43% of mass; then s, x; weaker y, 1, i, t, u, r) and the first original token (z, b strongest, then k, l, e, g, 3, o). Top activations are d/s at t=3-4 in sequences starting with z or b. Mostly first occurrences of the token. The predicate (d/s/x at t=2-6 with a favored first token) gets dev F1 0.47 / mass recall 0.60; the long tail of weak activations on other tokens and first tokens behaves like a thresholded continuous sum, so precision and recall are both incomplete.
